# Typless

Typless is an AI-powered document extraction platform that automates manual data entry from various documents using a simple API.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/typless/.

## Actions

- **Get Document Types** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all document types available in the account.
- **Get User Profile** (read-only): Retrieve the authenticated user profile.
- **Update User Profile**: Update the authenticated user's profile.
